name: digidollar
title: DigiDollar
summary: DigiByte's stablecoin: its price, supply and health from this arcade's DigiByte Cores, and minting and redeeming from your own wallet on DigiByte's test chain.

ddstats.help:
DigiDollar on this arcade's DigiByte: the oracle's price, the supply and how well it is backed.

ddstats [main|test]   the test chain (testnet26) unless you say main

ddcollateral.help:
The DGB a mint of this many dollars locks, for this long.

ddcollateral <dollars> [tier] [main|test]   tier 0 is one hour (test chains), 1 thirty days, up to 9 for ten years

ddmint.help:
Mint DigiDollars from your own DGB on DigiByte's test chain: it stays locked in a vault until the tier's time is up.

ddmint <dollars> [tier]   your wallet shows the transaction and signs it

ddvaults.help: Your DigiDollars and your vaults on DigiByte's test chain: what each vault holds, and when it unlocks.

ddredeem.help:
Redeem a vault once it unlocks: burn the DigiDollars it minted and take back all its DGB.

ddredeem <vault>   the vault's id, from ddvaults; your wallet shows the transaction and signs it
